name: Indeed
description: Indeed is an employment marketplace for job discovery, employer research, applications, recruiting, job posting, and sponsored hiring campaigns. Job seekers, employers, recruiters, applicant-tracking systems, and researchers use distinct Indeed products and data services.
agentUseSummary: Indeed cannot currently be connected as one Relay provider. Indeed's job-search MCP is beta and explicitly available only as a Claude Connector, while employer, candidate, posting, advertising, and disposition APIs require a provider-created partner application and role-specific contracts, and Hiring Lab research uses a separately reviewed API key. Relay will not represent these incompatible authorities as a generic Indeed account connection.

blocked.label: Connect an Indeed account
blocked.description: Indeed does not publish one distributable contract covering job-seeker, employer, ATS, agency, advertising, candidate, and research authority for a generic third-party connection.

blocked.label: Search Indeed jobs and companies
blocked.description: Indeed's current provider-hosted MCP supports job, company, job-detail, and resume tools only as a beta Claude Connector and is not documented for Relay distribution.

blocked.label: Manage employers or jobs
blocked.description: Employer creation, job creation, updates, expiration, status, and related reads require an approved ATS or agency partner contract and cannot be inferred for Relay or direct employers.

blocked.label: Manage candidates or dispositions
blocked.description: Applications, resumes, job-seeker identifiers, candidate sync, Indeed Apply, and disposition events remain blocked pending an exact approved partner role, privacy contract, and hiring-system workflow.

blocked.label: Manage sponsored jobs or research data
blocked.description: Paid campaigns, budgets, performance, predictions, and separately keyed Hiring Lab datasets are unavailable without their distinct commercial, billing, research, attribution, and verification contracts.

blocked.label: Use raw Indeed interfaces
blocked.description: Raw MCP mounting, arbitrary GraphQL, private APIs, browser automation, scraping, credential capture, unapproved job feeds, and cross-employer token reuse are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Indeed action is enabled until Indeed offers Relay a distributable job-search contract or product owners approve one exact partner role and Indeed provisions and verifies that integration.

runtimeSupport.description: Indeed's beta remote MCP is documented only for the Claude Connector, and its partner APIs require an approved role-specific integration.

providerSetup.blocker: The label Indeed spans a Claude-only beta job-search MCP; a separately keyed Hiring Lab research API; and partner-only OAuth, Job Sync, Job Update, Employer Data, Indeed Apply, Candidate Sync, Disposition Sync, sponsored-jobs, SCIM, and real-time products. These products serve incompatible job-seeker, researcher, ATS, agency, employer, advertiser, and Japan Indeed PLUS roles. Indeed provisions partner apps and scopes after a Developer Agreement and verifies integrations, Job Sync is explicitly unavailable to direct employers, and sponsored actions add billing and commercial commitments. Relay cannot select one authority without defining which product and business role it is undertaking.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product and legal owners must choose one bounded Indeed outcome. Prefer a distributable version of Indeed's provider-hosted job-search MCP if Indeed opens it beyond Claude; otherwise decide whether Relay will become an ATS, agency, advertising, or research partner and accept the corresponding data-processing, billing, completeness, interface, moderation, attribution, verification, support, and regional duties. The provider-console owner may contact Indeed only after that decision. Implementation must then pin typed wrappers, exact OAuth or API-key authority, employer and job-seeker isolation, bounded results and payloads, safe-mode approvals for every hiring or financial mutation, audits, redaction, deletion, and post-revocation denial.

evidence.supports: Indeed documents a beta remote MCP for job search, job details, company data, and the account holder's resume, but states that it is only available for the Claude Connector.
Indeed catalogs distinct candidate, disposition, employer, job, research, real-time, SCIM, and MCP integrations rather than one generic account API.
Indeed provisions partner applications and Partner Console access, with separate two-legged, three-legged, token-exchange, and Log in with Indeed OAuth flows.
Indeed's Job Sync API creates and manages job postings for ATS partners and is explicitly unavailable to direct employers.
Indeed issues separate Hiring Lab API keys to reviewed partners and researchers based on emailed use-case and organization details.
Indeed's role-specific APIs are governed by a Partner Developer Agreement, verification, end-user isolation, interface rules, and distinct sponsored-job billing requirements.
